Qubit & Bloch Sphere

A qubit's state lives on the surface of the Bloch sphere. Adjust θ and φ to see how the state vector moves.

02

Quantum Gates

Apply quantum gates to a qubit and watch its state transform in real time. Chain multiple gates to build complex operations.

03

Superposition & Measurement

A qubit in superposition is like a spinning coin — it exists in both states until measured. Run many measurements to see probability in action.

04

Quantum Entanglement

Entangled qubits are mysteriously linked — measuring one instantly determines the other, no matter the distance.

Quantum Circuit Builder

Build your own quantum circuit! Place gates on qubits and run the simulation to see the output state and probabilities.
